messages:
Alex: Quick sync — wheelhouse broadcast plan + SI readiness for EU/APAC cutover. We have press assets, landing staging, and SI runbook gaps. Can owners confirm slots?
Maya: I have the press kit almost ready, one legal blurb pending. ETA EOD PST.
Sam: SI checklist: we still need test tenants from partner X and a signed SSO cert for EU. Tracking: https://docs.internal/si-runbooks/marketplace-integration
Taylor: Landing staging URL is up: https://staging.redwood-inference/marketplace-eu. Can we freeze copy by 12:00 UTC tomorrow?
Jen: @Maya can legal expedite the blurb? Press wants to include hardware partner quote.
Maya: looping Legal (cc: @Luis) — Luis, can you review partner quote by 6pm PT?
Luis: Yup, I can take it. Quick heads-up — partner requires regionalized SLA blurb for EU and APAC.
Sam: For SI dry-run, propose these windows:
```
- Wed 09:00-11:00 UTC: EU integration smoke
- Wed 13:00-15:00 UTC: APAC partner validation
- Thu 10:00-12:00 UTC: full end-to-end with SI
```
Alex: Those look good. Can engineering guarantee no backend deploys during the smoke? @Taylor
Taylor: We will hold non-critical deploys. I’ll add a deploy freeze tag.
DeployBot: Deploy freeze scheduled: tag=marketplace-go-live-freeze window=1752470400-1752484800 (UTC) :lock:
Jen: Embargo question — press wants embargo until go-live+30m, legal ok with that?
Luis: Embargo approved. Add embargo note to press kit: 'Do not publish before 2025-04-10T15:00:00Z'.
Maya: Added embargo line and partner quote placeholder. Need final quote text from partner by 6pm PT or we use generic endorsement.
Alex: Action items:
- Maya: finalize press kit + send to partner for signoff (ETA EOD PT)
- Luis: finalize regional SLA blurb (ETA 6pm PT)
- Sam: confirm test tenants and share access instructions (ETA tomorrow 09:00 UTC)
- Taylor: lock landing copy and maintain deploy freeze (ETA 12:00 UTC)
- Jen: coordinate embargo and press list, confirm distribution channels
Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if on board or flag blockers now.
Maya: :thumbsup: will ping partner.
Sam: :thumbsup: creating tenant invites now.
Taylor: :thumbsup: landing team on it.
Jen: :thumbsup: will run distribution checklist.
Luis: :thumbsup: will share SLA before 6pm.
Alex: Great — last ask: if partners need hardware image manifests or AMI IDs, call them out in this thread now so infra can pre-provision.
Sam: Partner X asked for AMI ID list for eu-west-1 — will post in next message.
Alex: Awesome, thanks team. Will spin up a 30-min preflight call 1h before the first smoke window. Invite when assets are in.
Maya: Noted, will share final press preview link in thread once signed.
